title.narrative: GrowthAfrica Foundation - Strengthening capacity of SMs to integrate circular economy principles into their core business.
GrowthAfrica Foundation - Strengthening capacity of SMs to integrate circular economy principles into their core business.

description.narrative: The purpose of the project is to strengthen the capacity of Kenyan Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (SMEs) to adopt circular economy practices within their core business operations. The project aims to improve the profitability of participating SMEs by enhancing their operational efficiency, providing business development support, and strengthening their marketing and innovation capabilities. It will also help SMEs access finance and investment by creating targeted networking and visibility opportunities. In doing so, the project seeks to support SME growth and increase employment, especially for youth. To ensure long-term impact, the project will implement a proactive stakeholder engagement strategy that creates a strong and interactive ecosystem around the SMEs. In addition, the project will map Finnish companies whose technologies or business models can be applied in the Kenyan con-text. It will then organize both virtual and physical matchmaking events to enable direct introductions, promote collaboration, and highlight opportunities for technology transfer, investment, and market entry for Finnish companies interested in Kenya’s growing circular economy. GrowthAfrica Foundation will support 10 – 15 SMEs to integrate circular economy practices into their operations and value chains. The focus will be on improving resource efficiency, reducing waste, and adopting sustainable production and consumption models.
